data.one_liner: A mock framework inspired by Mockito with APIs for Fakes, Mocks, behavior verification, and stubbing.
data.what_it_does: Provides APIs to create mock and fake classes for testing Dart and Flutter applications. It supports behavior verification, method stubbing, argument matchers, and code generation for null-safe classes.
use_when: You need to test classes that depend on external services or complex dependencies.
You want to verify interactions, arguments, and call orders on mocked objects.
avoid_when: You can easily construct real instances or tested fake implementations for your tests.
You prefer runtime-only mocking libraries that do not require build_runner.
strengths: Robust behavior verification and stubbing features.
Supports null safety and generates nice mocks to avoid runtime type exceptions.
weaknesses: Requires running build_runner for code generation.
Has an awkward syntax requirement for naming arguments within argument matchers.
data.setup_notes: Add build_runner to dev_dependencies and run `dart run build_runner build` to generate mock classes.

alternatives.name: mocktail
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want a mock framework with similar features to Mockito but without the need for code generation.
